statusDetail: The attempted raw-CDP navigation and a separate HTTP fetch were intercepted by a Cloudflare managed bot challenge. The browser remained on “Performing security verification”, and the direct response was HTTP 403 with cf-mitigated: challenge, so arca.live content, routes, and flows were not observable.

page.notes: Only Cloudflare challenge markup was observable. Site architecture and representative templates could not be discovered.
